title: Godot 4.6.rc1: macOS Metal white screen and can crash with the lazy flag
body:
### Tested versions

- Broken on Godot 4.6.rc1
- Works on Godot 4.5.1

### System information

macOS 15.6.1 - Macbook Air M3 15"

### Issue description

I havent investigated much yet, but a scene that works in Godot 4.5.1 crashes on Godot 4.6.rc1:

```
ERROR: Failed to compile Metal library
   at: _create_function (drivers/metal/rendering_device_driver_metal.mm:1799)
ERROR: Condition "std::holds_alternative<Error>(function_or_err)" is true. Returning: PipelineID()
   at: compute_pipeline_create (drivers/metal/rendering_device_driver_metal.mm:2243)
ERROR: Condition "!pipeline.driver_id" is true. Returning: RID()
   at: compute_pipeline_create (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:4342)
ERROR: Parameter "pipeline" is null.
   at: compute_list_bind_compute_pipeline (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:5392)
```
In addition, the 3D pipeline produces a "white screen". I've seen this before, that time it was that SSIL produced `nan` in the draw calls for D3D12. Disabling it solved the problem or using Vulkan solved the problem. That was (and is) an issue on 4.5.1. 

This new issue on macOS metal looks exactly the same but is caused by something different. After clearing the os metal caches and the Godot caches it still happens. I havent tracked down the issue yet. 

### Steps to reproduce

This is tricker since I havent taken the time to find the problematic shader or code in addition to the stack trace above:

- In export, add 

```
  <key>LSEnvironment</key>
  <dict>
      <key>GODOT_MTL_SHADER_LOAD_STRATEGY</key>
      <string>lazy</string>
  </dict>
```

then export and run my game and it crashes every time. The white screen also happens. 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I dont have one yet. As soon as I find the problematic shader or code, I will share it. I thought you want to know about this as soon as possible since Godot 4.6 is in RC status.
